_kind: authored framework policy — do not derive; the boot document set is authored
_note: Machine-readable projection of the Boot Context (ART-BOOT-001, CONTEXT_ARTIFACTS §2.1). Restates no policy. No framework_version field: VERSION.yaml is the sole version authority, and the boot cache key is a content digest of these documents (a blob-digest form §3.1 already permits), NOT the version string — so a version bump that changes no boot document does not invalidate Boot Context (§8, reduced invalidation scope). load: eager = resolved at boot; lazy = resolved on demand (§1.3).
